name: charm_quark

phase_0.boundary_condition: The QCD confinement scale Λ_QCD ≈ 200 MeV forms an absolute boundary — charm quarks cannot exist as free asymptotic states and must hadronize into color-singlet charmed mesons (D⁰, D⁺, D_s⁺) or baryons (Λ_c⁺) within ~10⁻²³ seconds.

⊢.justification: The uninitialized charm quark field before electroweak symmetry breaking; void state with no mass, no flavor distinction, gauge symmetry unbroken.

⊣.justification: Terminal anchor — the QCD confinement scale that absolutely contains the charm quark; no free charm exists outside hadrons.

≻.justification: Forward morphism — charm quark propagating through spacetime engaging gauge vertices (gluon, photon, W/Z emission) toward mass shell.

≺.justification: Reverse morphism — flavor-changing weak decay c → s + W⁺ where charm identity is lost and strange quark emerges; register clears for new flavor.

⋈.justification: Composition — chains sequential vertices: gluon emission → parton shower → hadronization, or W emission → leptonic/semileptonic decay products.

⊙.justification: Self-reference — charm quark carries intrinsic quantum numbers (charge +2/3, charm +1, color triplet) as identity at every vertex.

∈.justification: Electroweak interaction splits charm field into left-handed doublet (c_L, s_L) coupling to W/Z and right-handed singlet c_R coupling only to photon/gluon — two arms with different gauge couplings.

∋.justification: Higgs Yukawa coupling rejoins left and right components into massive Dirac fermion; arms fuse with transformed content (mass acquisition 1.27 GeV).

⊤.justification: Affirmative arm — left-handed component participates in charged-current weak interactions (c → s W⁺), establishing flavor change.

⊥.justification: Negative arm — both chiralities couple identically to gluons (QCD), preserving flavor; the 'no flavor change' branch.

⊞.justification: Paradice — charm quark simultaneously holds |c⟩ and |s⟩ flavor components through CKM mixing (V_cs ≈ 0.97, V_cd ≈ 0.22); both flavor eigenstates live in same state until weak vertex resolves flavor.

⊡.justification: Irreversible fixation — moment charm quark hadronizes into D meson or Λ_c baryon, event permanently recorded in detector; free quark state cannot be recovered.

phase_2.failure_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.void_description: Pre-Yukawa vacuum: no charm mass, no flavor eigenstate distinction, gauge symmetry unbroken.
phase_3.true_description: Charm quark produced on-shell with definite momentum, flavor, and color — confirmed particle state in detector.
phase_3.false_description: Charm quark virtual/off-shell, or flavor-changed to strange via weak decay — original charm identity negated.
phase_3.both_description: CKM superposition: propagating quark simultaneously charm and strange (|c⟩ + V_cs|s⟩ + V_cd|d⟩) until weak vertex resolves flavor; also chiral paradox where left-handed component is weak-charged and right-handed is neutral, held together by mass.

steps.domain_action: Initialize bare charm quark field in pre-electroweak vacuum — void state with no mass, no flavor distinction.
Establish self-reference — field carries intrinsic quantum numbers (charge +2/3, color triplet, charm +1) as identity.
Forward morphism — propagate bare field toward electroweak symmetry breaking scale.
Fix Yukawa coupling parameter — charm mass term permanently written into Lagrangian.
Split into chiral components — left-handed doublet (c_L, s_L) entering weak isospin space, right-handed singlet c_R entering only vector gauge space.
On T-arm (left-handed), deposit weak charged-current coupling — c_L → s_L + W⁺ vertex affirmed, flavor change enabled.
Forward morphism on T-arm — propagate left-handed component through weak interaction vertices (W emission, CKM mixing).
Compose sequential weak vertices — chain W emission with subsequent decay products.
Reverse morphism on T-arm — flavor reversal transforms charm into strange; original charm identity negated.
On F-arm (right-handed), deposit strong/EM neutral-current coupling — gluon and photon vertices preserve flavor, no weak charge.
Forward morphism on F-arm — propagate right-handed component through QCD vertices (gluon emission, hadronization).
Compose sequential strong vertices — chain gluon emissions into parton shower.
At mass insertion point, hold both chiralities simultaneously — Dirac mass term couples c_L and c_R, creating paradice of massive fermion with both weak and vector couplings active.

Rejoin chiral arms via Higgs Yukawa coupling — massless split inputs fuse into massive charm quark (1.27 GeV) with both chiralities present; result is new massive eigenstate, not original massless field.
Self-reference of massive charm quark — identity now includes mass as fixed parameter in propagator.
Split interaction channels — weak decay arm (c → s W⁺) vs strong/EM arm (gluon/photon emission, hadronization).
On weak arm, affirm flavor-changing charged current — charm quark decays via c → s + W⁺ (dominant) or c → d + W⁺ (suppressed), establishing 'charm lost' state.
Forward morphism on weak arm — propagate W boson to leptonic or hadronic final states.
Chain weak decay products — W⁺ → e⁺ν_e or μ⁺ν_μ or hadrons; sequential composition of decay vertices.
Reverse morphism on weak arm — flavor reversal completes; register clears for new strange quark flavor.
On strong arm, affirm flavor-conserving QCD — gluon emission, color exchange, no flavor change; charm quantum number persists.
Forward morphism on strong arm — propagate through parton shower, gluon splitting, color flow.
Compose parton shower sequence — sequential gluon emissions and splittings.
At hadronization, hold both perturbative (quark) and non-perturbative (hadron) descriptions simultaneously — charm quark is both free parton in shower and confined constituent in D meson.

Rejoin decay and hadronization arms at final state — weak arm produces leptons + strange hadrons, strong arm produces charmed hadrons; they fuse into complete event record with both charm and strange hadrons present (associated production).
Permanently fix hadronization event — D⁰, D⁺, D_s⁺, or Λ_c⁺ in detector is irreversible record; free charm quark state gone.
Terminal anchor — confinement boundary closes system; all charm quantum numbers now carried by color-singlet hadrons, no free charm remains.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Standard Model Lagrangian with SU(3)_c × SU(2)_L × U(1)_Y gauge symmetry and Higgs Yukawa sector — translates charm quark parameters (mass, CKM elements, charges) into Feynman rules and vertex factors.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Gauge boson exchange (gluons, W/Z, photon) mediates communication between charm quark and other fields; color flow and weak isospin are communication channels.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Quantum numbers (flavor, color, charge, mass) stored in field's propagator and vertex structures; parton distribution functions encode charm content of hadrons; detector records fix final states.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Renormalization group flow orders operations by energy scale: electroweak symmetry breaking (100 GeV) → charm mass threshold (1.27 GeV) → parton shower (GeV) → hadronization (Λ_QCD) → detector (MeV).
phase_5.alfs_store: Particle Data Group (PDG) review of charm quark properties — masses, lifetimes, branching ratios, CKM matrix elements — serves as canonical reference store for this domain.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Each weak vertex costs ~G_F²E⁴ phase space suppression; each strong vertex costs α_s ~ 0.3; hadronization costs non-perturbative binding energy ~Λ_QCD.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: High-energy collision produces charm-anticharm pair in color-octet state with definite flavor quantum numbers.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Final state hadrons (D mesons, strange hadrons, leptons) with charm quantum number distributed across color-singlet bound states; total entropy increases through parton shower and hadronization multiplicity.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — Charm quark lifetime (τ ~ 10⁻¹² s) allows perturbative QCD evolution but weak decay and hadronization are near-deterministic given initial quantum numbers; cycle conserves information in S-matrix sense (unitarity), entropy increase only from coarse-graining over unobserved color/soft gluon degrees of freedom.
